input.content: Pattern: premature removal of dual-shape read during a bounded/background data migration (expand-contract violated). A "cleanup" drops the legacy-shape fallback in a reader (e.g. `return row["destination"]["address"]` instead of checking `"destination" in row` and falling back to `row["address"]`) while migration is still batched and no startup gate exists. Any unmigrated record raises KeyError, and a list comprehension over all records fails the whole read path. Detection cues: README/contract says "must read both shapes until migration finishes"; migrate_batch has a limit; the fixture/snapshot contains legacy rows; tests only cover the new-write shape, so the suite stays green. Fix: keep the dual read and defer removal until migration completion is verified (no record lacks the new key). Add tests that list the mixed snapshot before, partway through and after migration. Severity P1 (read path unavailable, data intact, revertible).
